subject.title: Feature Request: Add production-readiness stability label to releases

question: Should OpenClaw make an official per-release readiness promise, and what validation threshold and known-issue process may assign, update, or revoke that state?
rationale: Current channels and validation artifacts provide useful evidence but do not define the requested product assurance; release owners must choose its semantics and acceptable confidence level.

options.title: Add evidence-backed readiness states
options.body: Define a small readiness taxonomy with objective release gates, exception links, ownership, and a post-publication update or revocation process.

options.title: Publish evidence without a verdict
options.body: Keep stable, beta, and dev channels authoritative while improving release notes so operators make their own deployment-specific risk decision.

options.title: Wait for release-train shadowing
options.body: Complete the proposed advisory release-train trial before deciding whether its evidence should generate a public readiness state.

recommendation.title: Add evidence-backed readiness states
recommendation.body: Define a small readiness taxonomy with objective release gates, exception links, ownership, and a post-publication update or revocation process.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner for release-policy and product-assurance decisions based on the related-issue routing history.
